page_title: LEN 2-0 BRE | Lens v Brest 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' The Brest players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
90+1' A cross is slung in towards the penalty spot and Mahdi Camara (Brest) creates space for himself but sends his header inches over the bar.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Will Still has decided to make a change. Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) replaces Andy Diouf.
90' It's time for a substitution. Luc Zogbe (Brest) comes on in place of Jordan Amavi.
88' Deiver Machado (Lens) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
87' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
87' Andy Diouf (Lens) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Lens win a corner.
85' The current number of shots on goal is 10:2.
83' A yellow card for a tackle by Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens). Jeremie Pignard doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
82' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
79' Eric Roy decides to make a substitution. Ludovic Ajorque will be replaced by Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest).
79' Substitution. Romain Faivre makes way for Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
78' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
78' Facundo Medina (Lens) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
75' Here comes a substitution. Deiver Machado (Lens) is brought on as a substitute for Jhoanner Chavez.
75' Will Still has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) replacing Jonathan Gradit.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Remy Labeau Lascary as he is replaced by Martin Satriano (Lens).

74' Andy Diouf (Lens) weaves through the defence with ease and gets into a good position in front of goal. He pulls the trigger in an effort to beat the keeper, but fails as the ball zooms around the right post.
72' Jordan Amavi (Brest) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Brice Samba makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
70' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Brest was in an offside position.
69' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
68' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
67' The main referee, Jeremie Pignard, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Romain Faivre (Brest) is given a yellow card for dissent.
67' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) gets booked for the first time in this match.
66' That's the end of the game for Anass Zaroury, who is replaced by Angelo Fulgini (Lens).
64' Here is a change. Jonas Martin is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Abdallah Sima (Brest).

63' Marco Bizot makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Anass Zaroury (Lens) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lens.

63' What a wasted opportunity by Florian Sotoca (Lens)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Marco Bizot makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
61' Florian Sotoca (Lens) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
59' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul after Andy Diouf (Lens) hacks down one of his opponents.
57' Romain Faivre (Brest) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Hugo Magnetti and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
55' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
54' Florian Sotoca (Lens) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Marco Bizot.
54' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
53' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Anass Zaroury (Lens) causes Marco Bizot little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
52' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Romain Del Castillo (Brest). The ball is out of play. Brest will have a chance to score from a corner.
50' Brest fail to score from a corner as Brice Samba (Lens) leaps to collect the ball.
50' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Brest have a corner.
47' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
46' The game is interrupted now, Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Jeremie Pignard has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

45' 2 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Julien Le Cardinal (Brest), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the middle of his own goal and behind the goalkeeper.
43' Anass Zaroury (Lens) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
42' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for an infringement. Lens get a free kick.
39' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
38' Florian Sotoca (Lens) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Bizot, who smothers the ball.
36' A pass from Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is intercepted by Marco Bizot and the move breaks down.
34' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

34' Anass Zaroury (Lens) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Marco Bizot pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lens.
33' Jonas Martin (Brest) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
31' Anass Zaroury (Lens) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
30' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
30' Jeremie Pignard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jonathan Gradit (Lens).
29' Mahdi Camara (Brest) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
27' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
26' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
25' Jordan Amavi (Brest) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
25' Jordan Amavi (Brest) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Lens have a free kick.
24' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) trips an opposition player and Jeremie Pignard signals a foul.
23' Florian Sotoca (Lens) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post.
19' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) receives a precise pass inside the box from Anass Zaroury and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
17' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) for a tough tackle.
17' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jeremie Pignard stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
15' Brest are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jonathan Gradit (Lens), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
11' Hugo Magnetti (Brest) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.

10' Anass Zaroury (Lens) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Marco Bizot pulls off an easy save.
10' One of the players from Lens times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
7' The free kick is taken by Jhoanner Chavez (Lens), but ball is cleared.
6' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle after Jordan Amavi (Brest) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Lens in a dangerous position.
6' Anass Zaroury (Lens) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
3' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) attempts a nice header from inside the penalty area, but his effort is blocked.
1' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort flies narrowly over the bar.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Lens will take the kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard is the one to supervise the game today.
